problem: The file is opened in write mode, which truncates it and makes json.load fail; it should be opened for reading.
The loop stops at len(items) - 1, so the last item is left out of the total.
The mutable default argument tags=[] is shared across calls, so tags accumulate instead of starting empty each call.
The comparison uses > instead of >=, so an item with exactly qty in stock is wrongly reported as not fulfillable.
The percent is divided by 10 instead of 100, giving a discount ten times too large.
The comparison is reversed (> instead of <), returning items with stock above the reorder level rather than below.
Using 'or 1' turns a quantity of 0 (cancelled order) into 1; only a missing qty should default to 1.
